subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: Should this external PR be allowed to carry the four shrinkwrap dependency graph changes, or should those files be restored before merge?
rationale: OpenClaw policy and the live dependency graph guard require explicit admin/secops authorization for external dependency graph changes, and automation cannot infer that approval from the verifier implementation itself.

options.title: Remove the shrinkwrap refresh
options.body: Restore the four shrinkwrap files from the target branch so the PR only contains the verifier primitive and shared Ed25519 refactor.

options.title: Authorize this exact dependency graph change
options.body: A repository admin or secops owner can explicitly approve the current head if the shrinkwrap deltas are intentionally part of the merge.

options.title: Pause the trust-series slice
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged until the verifier and dependency graph changes are split or the security owner decision is made.

recommendation.title: Remove the shrinkwrap refresh
recommendation.body: Restore the four shrinkwrap files from the target branch so the PR only contains the verifier primitive and shared Ed25519 refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick is the current assignee and already repaired verifier check issues on this PR, making him the best visible owner to route the dependency-graph decision or split.
